objective_for_doctor:
Age: 57
Sex: Female
Chief Complaint: I have a fever, sensitive pain, and forehead pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi doctor. I’ve had a fever and really sensitive pain, especially in my forehead. I also have a sore throat and nasal congestion/clear runny nose, and the pain is on both my temples and my left cheek.
[ASK] Do you have a fever (≥38°C) and body aches (general flu-like symptoms)?
Yes, I have a fever. I also feel flu-like and achy all over, with the pain being very sensitive.
[ASK] Do you have fever (≥38°C) with sudden onset of symptoms (starting within the last 7 days)?
Yes, it started pretty suddenly within the last week. It came on fast.
[ASK] Do you have a fever (≥38°C) with new ear pain or ear discharge?
No, I don’t have new ear pain or any ear discharge.
